_note: SPEC-118 deposit-breadth metric thresholds. window_h = trailing window a breadth read covers; baseline_windows = how many prior windows form the baseline (mean); spike_multiple = current senders >= baseline * this = spike candidate; usd_floor = total USD (stable-leg/spot-priced) must also clear this; min_abs_senders = small-sample guard (absolute floor regardless of ratio, so a near-zero baseline can't blow the ratio up into a false spike); days = transfer-log lookback; young_nonce_max reuses SPEC-98's fresh-wallet fingerprint (config/rotation_freshness.json onchain_young_nonce_max); max_channels bounds provider reads.
